title: The Landfall of the Sepik Basin
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Dominic Montrose, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
